front: Name five threats to indigenous culture.
back: Media and the internet, urbanisation, migration, globalisation, loss of language (also some religious attitudes, commercialisation).

front: Why is foreign influence not all negative?
back: It brought schooling, medicine, technology and human rights, which many Zimbabweans value.

front: Why does language loss threaten culture?
back: Proverbs, folk tales, totem praises and history are carried in the language; without it they cannot be passed on.

front: Name four ways of preserving indigenous culture.
back: Teaching languages; family practice; festivals and culture days; museums and local-language media (also the arts).
